title: [spec-gap][R-02-016] ASSIGNED_SF not wired end-to-end in Rust; C least-loaded tracker production-dead (spec 02 3.4)
description: Req R-02-016 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.4): gateway assigns least-loaded SF; nodes MUST use assigned SF for all TX after joining. DIVERGENT per stack: C emit landed (lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c:212-228 appends 0x14 TLV) but emits root->dodag.assigned_sf which NOTHING on the gateway sets (init 0, dodag.c:234) so it is constant SF10; C consume works (dodag.c:673-680 -> lora_l2_assign_sf -> datarate, lora_l2.c:221-244,311). Rust emit exists but dormant: router.rs:1032-1050 appends 0x14 only when sf_tracker installed; install_sf_tracker (router.rs:1063-1065) has zero production callers (test-only router.rs:1408-1410); Rust RX consume absent (DIO option loop router.rs:528-557 ignores 0x14; parse_assigned_sf_option has no production callers; TX SF stays RadioConfig default 10). Both least-loaded trackers production-dead: Rust GatewaySfTracker (sf_assignment.rs:187-247), C lichen_rpl_sf_tracker (tests/rpl_sf_assignment only). Python: model only (link/sf_assignment.py), no DIO wiring. No end-to-end 'gateway assigns least-loaded -> node switches TX' test anywhere. Suggested placement: Rust router.rs DIO RX option handling + TX spreading_factor propagation; C gateway join/DAO hook into lichen_rpl_sf_tracker.
